published_prior_art.cite: CapitaoMiniconiGassiatLehericy2025 identifies the latent law and independent errors, but not the outcome-weighted signed channel or causal ADRF.
KatoSasaki2019 gives a uniform EIV regression band under an invertible conventional operator; KatoSasakiUra2021 gives a density band.
Low1997 supplies the testing-to-length device, but not blind-replicate ADRF alternatives with a fixed noisy-treatment marginal.
No verified paper supplies matching honest simultaneous-band width bounds for the stated blind, nonidentical, open-zero replicate ADRF model.
HuangZhang2023 identifies the continuous-treatment ADRF with a known error characteristic function under unconfoundedness, consistency, and positivity.
No verified source characterizes honest adaptation across the proposed blind spectral-strength subclasses.

novelty_flags.label: prop:known-error-benchmark
novelty_flags.one_line: This is an explicitly credited known-error ADRF identification reduction already covered by HuangZhang2023, so it should be retained only as a labelled sanity reduction rather than a novel root proposition.

soundness_flags.label: def:hard-subclass; thm:all-honest-width-lower; thm:fixed-class-minimax-width
soundness_flags.one_line: The fixed model permits an arbitrary fixed finite Xset with every stratum mass at least pmin, whereas HardClass requires Xset to have one element; thus Mstar need not be a subclass of M and can be empty.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Journal abstract and article metadata, pp. 4141-4173
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies two repeated measurements with independent additive errors, establishes identification without noise-transform nonvanishing assumptions, gives compact-support minimax density-rate results, and discusses adaptation.

The repeated-measurement model uses identically distributed, totally independent replicate errors; its operative estimator assumes a real-valued nowhere-zero error transform and treats regression through a numerator-density ratio.

The paper constructs an asymptotically valid uniform confidence band for nonparametric EIV regression with unknown error distribution using validation data or repeated measurements and multiplier bootstrap.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 2, lines 106-152; Assumption 1 and the ADRF identification display
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The published model assumes a known measurement-error characteristic function and identifies the ADRF under unconfoundedness, consistency, and positivity.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Make the hard subclass compatible with the fixed finite-stratum model: either declare the headline class singleton-stratum or construct the same fixed-marginal Bernoulli alternatives in every positive-mass stratum.

Move the Huang--Zhang reduction out of the root solve-target list and label it a non-novel sanity check, preserving only the blind-replicate identification and matched-width theorems as research claims.

Sharpen the main comparison by isolating a theorem-level distinction from both Kato--Sasaki and Delaigle--Hall--Meister: blind nonidentical open-zero operators, simultaneous causal projection, and the all-honest width converse.

recommended_next_step: Revise the hard subclass so it is nonempty for the declared model, demote the known-error benchmark to a sanity reduction, then continue this field-tier angle to Stage 0.
